description: This file contains the implementation of the UpdateManager class in Drupal, responsible for managing update data, fetching updates, and handling project information within the Drupal update module.

classes.name: UpdateManager
classes.description: Implements update management functionalities such as fetching project data, refreshing update info, and handling update-related operations within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UpdateManager with required services and configurations.

methods.name: refreshUpdateData
methods.description: Clears cached project and update data, then initiates fetching of new update information.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieves the list of projects, rebuilding it if necessary, and caches it for an hour.

methods.name: projectStorage
methods.description: Manages storage and retrieval of project data, clearing cache on specific routes.

methods.name: fetchDataBatch
methods.description: Performs batch fetching of update data, processing queue items and updating progress.
